cards.question: Why might Chrysanthemum feel sad?
choices: Something new or unfamiliar is happening
cards.answer_hint: New experiences can make us feel sad.

cards.question: Why does the teacher help Chrysanthemum?
choices: She wants to make school feel safe and welcoming
cards.answer_hint: Teachers help new students feel included.

cards.question: Why might Chrysanthemum feel happy at the end?
choices: He made a friend and enjoyed the day
He didn't have to do anything
cards.answer_hint: When worries pass and we connect with others, we feel good.

cards.question: What might Chrysanthemum do with this?
choices: Use it to learn and play
cards.answer_hint: At school, we use things to learn and grow.
